lines.speaker: ferris
lines.text: Two sealed containers: fuel, plating, tools, one spare core.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Containers are the objective. This is not a fair fight and does not need to become one.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: Escort will be heavier because we rescued the witnesses first.

lines.speaker: ferris
lines.text: Fuel, plating, machine tools, and an overclock core that passed inspection in a philosophical sense.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Give me an hour. The repair gantry will move again.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: The quarry is still vulnerable. At least now we can defend it.

lines.speaker: ferris
lines.text: Convoy is moving. I can falsify another delay, but not forever.

midBattle.speaker: ferris
midBattle.text: Containers are marked. Crack them and leave the escort behind if you can.

midBattle.speaker: nyx
midBattle.text: Escort is reacting. Do not let them turn this into an elimination fight.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: Seal is weakening. Keep the impact away from the fuel cells.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: Repair drone is restoring the escort. Either pressure it or finish the containers.

midBattle.speaker: vale
midBattle.text: Both containers open. Take what we can carry and withdraw.
